madison-square-garden.description: MSG bag policy, checked Oct 2026: bags up to 22 x 14 x 9 in that fit under your seat. Plus what to do with a bigger bag, and how to get in and home.
faq: Can I bring a backpack to MSG?
Yes, if it fits under your seat and is no larger than 22" x 14" x 9". That limit is printed on MSG’s event pages.
Does my bag need to be clear?
No. MSG’s rule is about size, not clear bags. Any bag up to 22" x 14" x 9" that fits under your seat is allowed.
What if my bag is too big?
Bags larger than 22" x 14" x 9" aren’t allowed in. Leave it at home or at your hotel before you head to the Garden.

mortgage-matchup-center.description: Mortgage Matchup Center bag policy, checked Nov 2026: bags up to 14 x 14 x 6 in, and no backpacks. Plus how each event can change it, and the way home.
faq: Can I bring a backpack?
No. Backpacks of any size aren’t allowed, clear ones included.
How big can my bag be?
Bags must be within 14" x 14" x 6".
Is the bag policy the same for every show?
Not always. The venue says each event has its own bag and camera policy, so check your event’s page before you go.

spectrum-center.description: Spectrum Center bag policy, checked Nov 2026: bags up to 5 x 7 x 1.5 in, clear or not. Plus re-entry, and what to do if your bag is too big.
faq: Can I bring a backpack?
No. Backpacks are not allowed, and neither are totes, camera bags or drawstring bags.
Can I bring a clear bag?
Only if it’s within 5" x 7" x 1.5". The limit is the same for clear and non-clear bags, so a large clear tote won’t get in.
Is there a bag check?
No. Spectrum Center doesn’t store bags, so leave anything bigger in your car or at home.
Can I leave and come back in?
No, unless arena staff approve it before you leave.

oakland-arena.description: Oakland Arena bag policy, checked Nov 2026: bags smaller than 14 x 14 x 6 in, and no backpacks of any size. Plus re-entry, parking, and the way home.
faq: Can I bring a backpack?
No. Backpacks of any size aren’t allowed inside Oakland Arena.
How big can my bag be?
Bags must be smaller than 14" x 14" x 6". A clear bag isn’t required.
Is there a bag check?
No. Bag check isn’t open for events at Oakland Arena, so leave larger bags in your car.
Can I leave and come back in?
No. There’s no re-entry once you exit.

brooklyn-paramount.description: Brooklyn Paramount bag policy, checked Nov 2026: clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 in, small bags up to 6 x 9 in. Plus bag check and re-entry.
faq: Do I need a clear bag?
Only if your bag is bigger than 6" x 9". Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags are allowed up to 12" x 6" x 12".
What if my bag is too big?
Bags over the size limits must be checked for a fee. Coat check is guaranteed if you buy it in advance; walk-up is first come, first served.
Can I bring a hydration pack?
No. Hydration packs and coolers aren’t allowed.
Can I leave and come back in?
No. Re-entry isn’t allowed at Brooklyn Paramount events.

allstate-arena.description: Allstate Arena bag policy, checked Nov 2026: bags up to 12 x 12 in, and no backpacks or totes. Plus diaper and medical bags, parking, and rideshare.
faq: Can I bring a backpack?
No. Backpacks, totes, mid- and large-sized bags and coolers aren’t allowed.
How big can my bag be?
Up to 12" x 12".
What if my bag is too big?
There’s no bag check. Take it back to your car before you go in.
Are diaper bags and medical bags allowed?
Yes. Diaper bags with a child and medical bags are allowed after a security search.

shoreline-amphitheatre.description: Shoreline Amphitheatre bag policy, checked Nov 2026: clear totes up to 12 x 12 x 6 in, clutches up to 6 x 9 in. Plus chairs, re-entry, and parking.
faq: Can I bring a backpack?
No. Backpacks, duffel bags and other oversized bags aren’t allowed.
Do I need a clear bag?
Yes, for anything larger than a clutch. Clear plastic or PVC totes are allowed up to 12" x 12" x 6". A clutch up to 6" x 9" doesn’t need to be clear.
Can I bring a chair or blanket to the lawn?
Chairs aren’t allowed. Blankets are allowed up to 6’ x 6’.
Can I leave and come back in?
No. You’d need a new ticket to get back in.

gas-south-arena.description: Gas South Arena bag policy, checked Oct 2026: clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 in, clutches up to 4.5 x 6.5 in. Plus what’s not allowed, and parking.
faq: Can I bring a backpack?
No. Backpacks, duffel bags and rolling suitcases aren’t allowed.
Do I need a clear bag?
Yes. Gas South Arena has a clear bag policy: clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12", or a small clutch up to 4.5" x 6.5".
Are diaper bags and medical bags allowed?
Yes, with screening at entry.

bill-graham-civic-auditorium.description: Bill Graham Civic Auditorium bag policy, checked Nov 2026: no large bags, and Camelbaks must be empty. Plus the $3 coat check, and getting home.
faq: How big can my bag be?
Bill Graham doesn’t publish a size limit. Its official list says large bags aren’t allowed, so bring something small.
Can I bring a Camelbak or water bottle?
Yes. Empty Camelbaks, empty refillable bottles and factory-sealed water bottles are allowed.
Is there a coat check?
Yes. It’s on the basement level, open during all events, for $3 a tag.
Can I bring a totem?
Yes, if it’s under 6 ft tall, no more than 1/2 in thick, and made of light materials.

benchmark-international-arena.description: Benchmark International Arena bag policy, checked Nov 2026: bags up to 12 x 12 x 12 in, and they don’t need to be clear. Plus re-entry and parking.
faq: How big can my bag be?
Up to 12" x 12" x 12". Bags larger than that aren’t allowed.
Do I need a clear bag?
No. Benchmark International Arena doesn’t require clear bags. Bags larger than a small clutch go through an x-ray scanner.
Can I leave and come back in?
No. Re-entry isn’t allowed.
Is the policy the same for every concert?
It can change with the touring artist’s policy, so check your event’s page before you go.

merriweather-post-pavilion.description: Merriweather Post Pavilion bag policy, checked Nov 2026: bags up to 13 x 15 in, and only clear backpacks. Plus re-entry, the lawn, and parking.
faq: Can I bring a backpack?
Only a clear plastic backpack, up to 13" x 15". Other backpacks and backpack-style purses aren’t allowed.
How big can my bag be?
Up to 13" x 15". All bags are searched.
What if my bag isn’t allowed?
There’s no bag check. Take it back to your car.
Can I leave and come back in?
No, except during extreme weather. Keep your ticket if you go to your car for shelter.

the-anthem.description: The Anthem bag policy, checked Nov 2026: a small purse is fine, and backpacks go to the paid coat check. Plus re-entry, and the way home.
faq: Can I bring a backpack?
Yes, but it can’t go inside with you. Backpacks are searched and must go into the paid coat check.
How big can my bag be?
A small purse. Anything larger is searched and checked at coat check.
Where is coat check?
On the first floor, on the Maine Avenue side. It charges a fee and takes cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
Can I leave and come back in?
No. Re-entry isn’t allowed.

dos-equis-pavilion.description: Dos Equis Pavilion bag policy, checked Nov 2026: clutches up to 6 x 9 in, and clear bags up to 12 x 12 x 6 in. Plus re-entry, parking, and rideshare.
faq: Can I bring a backpack?
Only a clear one, within 12" x 12" x 6". Backpacks that aren’t clear aren’t allowed.
Do I need a clear bag?
Only if it’s bigger than 6" x 9". Small clutches, wristlets and fanny packs up to 6" x 9" don’t need to be clear.
What if my bag isn’t allowed?
There’s no bag check. Take it back to your car.
Can I leave and come back in?
No. You’d need a new ticket to get back in.

jiffy-lube-live.description: Jiffy Lube Live bag policy, checked Nov 2026: clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 in, and clutches up to 6 x 9 in. Plus chair bags, re-entry, and parking.
faq: Do I need a clear bag?
Only if it’s bigger than a small clutch. Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags are allowed up to 12" x 6" x 12"; clutches up to 6" x 9" don’t need to be clear.
Can I bring a chair bag?
No. Bags for camping-style chairs aren’t allowed.
Can I leave and come back in?
No. You’d need a new ticket to get back in.

td-garden.description: TD Garden bag policy, checked Nov 2026: bags up to 6 x 4 x 1.5 in, clear ones included. Plus the $15 bag check, re-entry, and parking.
faq: Can I bring a backpack?
Not inside. Any bag larger than 6" x 4" x 1.5" has to go to the Event Bag Check.
Is there a bag check?
Yes. The Event Bag Check is on Level 1, next to the box office on the east side of North Station. It costs $15 and opens 2 hours before the event. There are no lockers.
Do clear bags get a bigger limit?
No. Clear bags have the same 6" x 4" x 1.5" limit.
Can I leave and come back in?
No. Once your ticket is scanned, you can’t leave and come back.
